THE ANSWER IS PARTIAL, AND THE REQUESTER IS TOLD WHY
Scientific authorship cannot be erased — a published dataset with an author removed is a falsified record, and Art. 17(3)(d) provides for exactly this. The response letter states each retained category, the specific article relied on, and their right to complain to the supervisory authority.

ACCESS AND PORTABILITY ARE AUTOMATED
Art. 15 and Art. 20 requests assemble themselves — a complete machine-readable archive of everything held about the person, generated in minutes rather than by a person searching six systems.
JSON + original files, in a documented schema
includes derived data and inferences
includes who accessed their data and when
THE CLOCK IS THE DESIGN
One month from receipt, Art. 12(3). It is on every row, in the list and in the detail, counting in days rather than as a date — because "day 19 of 30" prompts action and "due 21 September" does not.
WHO IS THE CONTROLLER
For institutional accounts the university is the controller and SciCollab is the processor — so requests land here, in your console, not in our support queue. For personal accounts we are the controller and they land with us. The screen states which regime applies to each request.
ACCOUNT DELETION · A23
A researcher can also self-serve from their own settings without asking anyone. This console exists for the cases where they cannot, or where a partial answer needs a human decision.

WHAT MAKES THIS NOT A DARK PATTERN
Both buttons are the same size, colour and weight. Neither is "recommended".
The privacy-preserving state is pre-selected, not merely available.
Rejecting takes one click, the same as accepting — no second screen.
No re-prompt for six months, and never after a rejection.
